questions.text: What had Amir forgotten the night before his exam?
questions.hint: "He had woken up forty minutes late because he had forgotten to set his alarm the night before."

questions.text: Why did Bakyt turn off the taxi meter?
opts: He decided it wasn't Amir's fault
questions.correct: He decided it wasn't Amir's fault
questions.hint: "I'm not going to charge you for the wait. It wasn't your fault."

questions.text: Why had Daniyar been delaying his visit to his grandfather?
opts: He had told himself he was too busy
His grandfather asked him not to come
questions.correct: He had told himself he was too busy
questions.hint: "He had told himself that he was too busy, that the semester would end soon enough."

questions.text: Daniyar's grandfather told his stories dramatically.
questions.hint: "He told them without drama, in the same tone he might use to describe the weather."

questions.text: Amir's exam "went better than he ___ expected."
questions.hint: "The exam... went better than he HAD EXPECTED." Past Perfect — what he expected BEFORE the exam. ✅

questions.text: What has Daniyar been doing since the first visit to his grandfather?
questions.hint: "He has gone back twice since... He has been recording his grandfather's stories."

questions.text: What had Rustam arranged for 2 p.m.?
opts: A research presentation to Professor Akhmetov
questions.correct: A research presentation to Professor Akhmetov
questions.hint: "I had arranged to present my research project to Professor Akhmetov at 2 p.m."

questions.text: Why was the professor not in his office?
opts: He had been called to an emergency faculty meeting
questions.correct: He had been called to an emergency faculty meeting
questions.hint: "He had been called to an emergency faculty meeting at 1:45."

questions.text: How did Rustam feel by the time he started presenting?
questions.hint: "By the time I started speaking, I had calmed down. All the preparation I had done paid off."

questions.text: What did the professor say about the presentation?
opts: One of the best this year
questions.correct: One of the best this year
questions.hint: "One of the best student research presentations he had seen this year."

questions.text: Rustam said if he had known the outcome, he ___ have panicked less.
questions.hint: "If I had known it would end like that, I WOULDN'T have panicked so much." ✅

questions.text: Rustam's assistant had not tried to email him about the change.
questions.hint: "She had tried to email me, but I hadn't checked." — she DID try to email.

questions.text: Past Perfect is formed with:
questions.hint: Past Perfect = had (for ALL subjects) + past participle. ✅

questions.text: "When she arrived, he ___ already left." Choose.
questions.hint: Earlier action before arrival → Past Perfect. "He HAD already left." ✅

questions.text: "By the time I arrived, the exam ___ already ___." (start)
questions.hint: "By the time + PS → PP." "HAD ALREADY STARTED." ✅

questions.text: "I had went there." — What is wrong?
questions.hint: ✅ "I had GONE there." Past Perfect = had + PAST PARTICIPLE. "gone" ≠ "went".

questions.text: "Before she arrived, I ___ (finish) the report." Choose.
questions.hint: "Before + PS → earlier event = PP." "Before she arrived, I HAD FINISHED." ✅

questions.text: "After he ___ (leave), I cleaned." Choose.
questions.hint: "After + EARLIER action = PP." "After he HAD LEFT (PP), I cleaned (PS)." ✅

questions.text: "By the time" introduces the ___ event in the sequence.
questions.hint: "By the time + LATER event (PS) → earlier action = Past Perfect." ✅

questions.text: "Once she ___ (finish), she called her parents."
questions.hint: "Once + PP (completion) → result." "Once she HAD FINISHED, she called." ✅

questions.text: "He felt completely defeated." "Defeated" means:
questions.hint: "defeated" = feeling as if you've lost; without hope or energy.

questions.text: "He arrived with two minutes to spare." "Spare" here means:
questions.hint: "to spare" = extra; beyond what was needed. He arrived with time left over.

questions.text: "Stories about the famine years." "Famine" means:
opts: A period of severe food shortage
questions.correct: A period of severe food shortage
questions.hint: "famine" = widespread, severe shortage of food.

questions.text: "It was not a dramatic farewell." "Farewell" means:
questions.hint: "farewell" = a goodbye; a parting, especially a significant one.

questions.text: "The time was running out." "Running out" means:
questions.hint: "running out" = being used up; less and less of it remaining.
